name: Mythos Gates: Ascension Art Bible
purpose: Internal Art Bible built from current Codex. Maintains separate visual standards to prevent visual drift.
globalRules: Faction identity must be visible through materials, silhouette, symbols, texture, and posture before any generic fantasy trope.
deities are living extradimensional beings, not buildings, robots, statues, block stacks, or abstract architecture piles.
NPCs are non-playable lore characters whose costume must show role, faction duty, and personal history.
Creatures can be monstrous but must stay rooted in faction or Hollow logic rather than generic alien design.
Architecture can influence clothing, regalia, auras, weapons, and environment — never replace living anatomy for character assets.
No readable real-world text or logos; glyphs and marks must be abstract lore texture.

gods_deitys.standard: Divine character identity — actual gods and goddesses, NOT Deities as separate species
rules: Every playable character is an actual god or goddess — NOT mortal, NOT Deity creature, NOT alien
Each god needs a unique Divine Signature — no same glow/aura on everyone
Mythology must remain recognizable (authentic + Mythos Gates interpretation)
Signature weapons must have lore — legendary artifacts, not generic equipment
Unique silhouettes — no two gods mistaken for each other at distance
3D model ready — works from all angles
Combat readable at gameplay camera distance
One God at a Time — approval before next

ui.standard: World-consistent interface aesthetics. No visual drift.
rules: No readable real-world text or logos
Glyphs and marks must be abstract lore texture
UI must feel connected to the Mythos Gates universe

canonUpdate: Playable characters are actual gods and goddesses, NOT Deities as separate species
negativeRules: NEVER: generic fantasy warriors, knights, superheroes, RPG heroes, mortals, aliens, sci-fi, guns, spaceships, modern military, futuristic, cyberpunk, steampunk, unrelated mythology, clones, recolored templates, identical armor, flat sprites, cheap mobile, generic anime, random effects, realm/faction-inappropriate designs.
worldFormula: Gods + Mythology + Divine Powers + Melee + Magic + Legendary Artifacts + Extradimensional Mythos Gates
finalQualityTest: REALM: Could belong to this realm?
STYLE: Matches Mythos Gates: Ascension visual identity?
ORIGINALITY: Unique deity, not generic RPG character?
finalCreativeStandard: Every playable character should make the player think: That's a GOD → I know which god → I know the realm → I know the faction → I can see how the Mythos Gates shaped them.
